name: ARQ-5 Racing Quadcopter
description: A 220 mm racing quadcopter written in OpenSCAD: NACA-lofted keel, canopy and arms, brushless motors, propellers with spinners, a two-axis camera gimbal and an avionics stack, built from more than 30 part modules that each have their own GeoSpec check. Show the whole vehicle or any sub-assembly.
